requirements.quote: `assembleBrief(ctx, listingId)` returns all PRD PR-1 sections; each `BriefLine` carries `source_type`, `source_ref`, `anchor_id` (or `manual`), `confidence` and `confirmation_state`. A line with no provenance is not emitted. [type:unit]

Last order section shows 2-3 lines produced from the order's confirmed operative directions with a page-anchored link; if the extraction is unconfirmed the line is labelled 'Unconfirmed' and still anchored. No date appears that is absent from the anchored source text. [type:unit]
Open obligations are listed with owner, due date, status and the phrase pattern 'counter not yet filed; due 20 Oct'; overdue items sort first; closed obligations are excluded but counted. [type:unit]

Carry list is the union of (a) documents linked to open obligations, (b) the workspace's M2 'always carry' rules (when #74 wires memory; until then an empty provider), and (c) manual items; manual add, remove and tick persist in `brief_state` and survive re-assembly. [type:unit]

Synopsis (M3), last-hearing summary and court notes (M4) are fetched through the memory scope check; a clerk's brief omits synopsis strategy fields and M4 notes entirely (server-side, not hidden in the UI). [type:api]

Document context returns at most 5 matter-scoped passages with page and quote anchors, retrieved by pgvector or full-text within the matter only; it never returns a passage from another matter or workspace. [type:api]

`computeReadiness` returns a 0-100 score and per-segment booleans (stage known, last order present and confirmed, obligations reconciled, carry list reviewed) with human-readable reasons for each missing segment. [type:unit]
`markPrepared` records who and when; any later material change (new order, changed stage, new obligation) clears the mark and emits `brief.stale` with the reason. [type:unit]
Sensitive-matter flag (AI off): assembly skips AI compression and context retrieval from embeddings and still returns a deterministic brief. [type:unit]
Assembly p95 < 5 s per listing on the seeded dataset (target < 1.5 s deterministic path), and `brief.refresh` is idempotent (running twice yields the same row and no duplicate events). [type:unit]

A job refreshes briefs for all listings on tomorrow's board and for matters likely to be reached (all matters with a confirmed next date within 7 days), because advance notice in Karnataka is about one day. [type:unit]
All AI calls go through the gateway, are logged to `ai_call`, and run in India-only mode; the mock provider is used in CI. [type:api]
No outward action exists in this module: no send, export-to-third-party or filing function. [type:unit]
Cross-tenant tests pass: a user in workspace A cannot read or mutate this feature's rows in workspace B via SQL, service, server action or API, including a user who belongs to both. [type:api]
Every new tenant table has `workspace_id uuid not null`, an RLS policy using `app.workspace_id`, and is covered by the CI cross-tenant suite. [type:unit]
Inputs are validated with zod schemas from `packages/validators`; no `any` appears in exported types. [type:unit]

decisions.choice: MemoryProvider port with an empty default instead of reading memory tables
decisions.justification: #72 is open and no memory_item table exists (packages/core/src/lifecycle/deletion/memory.ts:23); the issue itself says 'until then an empty provider'. Role gating uses existing memory.read/strategy.read (packages/auth/src/policy/matrix.ts:22-24).

decisions.choice: Document context by full-text over document_page.search_tsv, not pgvector
decisions.justification: No document embedding table exists; document_page has a GIN tsvector (packages/db/src/schema/documents.ts:158,166); the AC allows 'pgvector or full-text'.

decisions.choice: brief.refresh and the sweep live in packages/core/src/jobs/definitions/, not apps/worker/src/jobs/
decisions.justification: apps/worker/src/jobs does not exist; every job is a defineJob in core and registered in jobs/registry.ts (extraction-extract-order.ts, portfolio-alert-scan.ts).

decisions.choice: Owner-defined SQL function app_brief_refresh_targets() for the cross-workspace sweep
decisions.justification: Tenant tables are under FORCE RLS so a system job cannot list workspaces directly; same pattern as app_portfolio_alert_targets (packages/core/src/jobs/definitions/portfolio-alert-scan.ts:48-52).

decisions.choice: Events (brief.stale) through an injected port, not a bus
decisions.justification: court-day does the same and emits only after the scope resolves (packages/core/src/court-day/scope.ts:30-45).

decisions.choice: Migration under packages/db/migrations with a timestamp name; seeds under packages/db/src/seed; ADR 0038
decisions.justification: Repo layout differs from the issue's paths (latest migration 20261024170000_court_day.sql; docs/adr ends at 0037).
